use smallvec::{SmallVec, smallvec};
use core::cell::Cell;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct Tracked<'a> { value: u64, drops: &'a Cell<usize> }
impl Drop for Tracked<'_> { fn drop(&mut self) { self.drops.set(self.drops.get() + 1); } }

fn main() {
    let mut values: SmallVec<[u64; 4]> = SmallVec::new();
    assert!(!values.spilled());
    for value in 0..17 { values.push(value); }
    assert!(values.spilled());
    values.truncate(3);
    values.shrink_to_fit();
    assert!(!values.spilled());
    values.insert(1, 31);
    values.insert_many(2, [41, 43, 47]);
    assert_eq!(values.remove(1), 31);
    let removed = values.swap_remove(2);
    values.retain(|value| *value % 2 == 1);
    let mut clone = values.clone();
    clone.extend_from_slice(&[59, 61]);
    let drained: Vec<_> = clone.drain(1..3).collect();
    println!("smallvec {:?} {:?} {:?} {removed}", values, clone, drained);
    let owned = clone.into_vec();
    let converted: SmallVec<[u64; 4]> = SmallVec::from_vec(owned);
    println!("converted {:?}", converted);
    let list: SmallVec<[u64; 4]> = smallvec![3, 5, 7];
    let repeat: SmallVec<[u64; 4]> = smallvec![11; 6];
    println!("macros {:?} {:?}", list, repeat);
    let left = [1, 2];
    let right = [3, 4, 5];
    let mut borrowed: SmallVec<[&[u64]; 4]> = SmallVec::new();
    borrowed.push(&left);
    borrowed.push(&right);
    for _ in 0..8 { borrowed.push(&right); }
    assert_eq!(borrowed[0], &left);
    println!("borrowed {} {}", borrowed.len(), borrowed.iter().map(|slice| slice.len()).sum::<usize>());
    let drops = Cell::new(0);
    let mut tracked: SmallVec<[Tracked<'_>; 2]> = SmallVec::new();
    for value in 0..13 { tracked.push(Tracked { value, drops: &drops }); }
    {
        let mut drain = tracked.drain(2..9);
        assert_eq!(drain.next().unwrap().value, 2);
    }
    assert_eq!(drops.get(), 7);
    assert_eq!(tracked.len(), 6);
    let duplicate = tracked.clone();
    drop(tracked);
    drop(duplicate);
    assert_eq!(drops.get(), 19);
    let mut zst: SmallVec<[(); 4]> = SmallVec::new();
    for _ in 0..129 { zst.push(()); }
    assert_eq!(zst.into_iter().count(), 129);
    println!("drops {} zst 129", drops.get());
}
